rv.q: "Radial Gradient" exposes the hypocrisy of the well-intentioned but overzealous political left while offering a path toward a healthy middle ground.
Radial Gradient would be a good fit for those who love plays that discuss and dissect social issues.
This is 90 minutes ( no intermission) of pure action and learning about people and personalities.

cn.t: Critics find this examination of race and campus hate crimes timely but uneven, with reviewers praising its ambition to tackle systemic issues while noting the execution doesn't fully deliver on its provocative premise.
